2.description: Summons rain for 5 turns when the Pokemon enters battle. Lasts 8 turns if holding a Damp Rock.

12.description: Prevents infatuation and Taunt, and makes the Pokemon unaffected by Intimidate.

20.description: Prevents confusion and makes the Pokemon unaffected by Intimidate.

21.description: Prevents the Pokemon from being forced out of battle by other Pokemon's moves or items.

23.description: Prevents opposing Pokemon from fleeing or switching out. Does not affect Ghost-type Pokemon.

26.description: Makes the Pokemon 'raised' being immune to Ground-type moves and unaffected by Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and Arena Trap.

27.description: Contact has a 30% chance to poison, paralyze, or put the attacker to sleep. Grass-type Pokemon, Pokemon with Overcoat, and Safety Goggles holders are immune.

35.description: Prevents the Pokemon's accuracy from being lowered and ignores changes to the target's evasiveness.

39.description: Prevents flinching and makes the Pokemon unaffected by Intimidate.

42.description: Prevents opposing Steel-type Pokemon from fleeing or switching out. Does not trap Ghost-type Pokemon.

45.description: Summons a sandstorm for 5 turns when the Pokemon enters battle. Lasts 8 turns if holding a Smooth Rock.

46.description: Causes opponents to spend 1 additional PP when using moves against the Pokemon.

51.description: Prevents the Pokemon's accuracy from being lowered and ignores changes to the target's evasiveness.

56.description: Contact has a 30% chance to infatuate an attacker of the opposite gender.

62.description: Increases Attack by 50% while affected by a major status condition and prevents burn from reducing physical damage.

70.description: Summons harsh sunlight for 5 turns when the Pokemon enters battle. Lasts 8 turns if holding a Heat Rock.

71.description: Prevents grounded opposing Pokemon from fleeing or switching out. Does not affect Ghost-type Pokemon.

79.description: Boosts move power by 25% against targets of the same gender and lowers it by 25% against targets of the opposite gender. Has no effect if either Pokemon's gender is unknown.

81.description: Boosts the Pokemon's evasiveness by 25% during snow.

82.description: Causes Berries that normally activate at 1/4 max HP or less to activate at 1/2 max HP or less instead.

86.description: Doubles the number of stat stages the Pokemon gains or loses from stat changes.

92.description: Causes variable multi-hit moves to hit the maximum number of times.

95.description: Boosts Speed by 50% while affected by a major status condition. Paralysis does not lower the Pokemon's Speed.

96.description: Changes affected moves to Normal type and boosts their power by 20%.

97.description: Boosts critical-hit damage by 50%, causing critical hits to deal 2.25x normal damage.

107.description: Alerts the Pokemon upon entering battle if an opponent knows a super-effective damaging move or a one-hit KO move.

113.description: Allows Normal-type and Fighting-type moves to hit Ghost-type Pokemon and makes the Pokemon unaffected by Intimidate.

115.description: Restores 1/16 of the Pokemon's max HP at the end of each turn during snow.

117.description: Summons snow for 5 turns when the Pokemon enters battle. Lasts 8 turns if holding an Icy Rock.

119.description: Reveals the held items of opposing Pokemon when the Pokemon enters battle.

120.description: Boosts the power of moves that cause recoil or crash damage by 20%.

124.description: Steals an attacker's held item when hit by a contact move if the Pokemon is not already holding an item.

128.description: Raises Attack by 2 stages when an opponent lowers any of the Pokemon's stats.

130.description: When hit by a damaging move, has a 30% chance to Disable that move for 4 turns.

133.description: When hit by a physical move, lowers Defense by 1 stage and raises Speed by 2 stages.

137.description: Boosts the power of physical moves by 50% while the Pokemon is poisoned.

138.description: Boosts the power of special moves by 50% while the Pokemon is burned.

139.description: Has a 50% chance to restore a consumed Berry at the end of each turn. Always succeeds in harsh sunlight.

141.description: At the end of each turn, raises a random Attack, Defense, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, or Speed stat by 2 stages and lowers a different one by 1 stage.

142.description: Prevents damage from sandstorms and protects the Pokemon from powder and spore moves and abilities.

147.description: Reduces the accuracy of status moves used against the Pokemon to 50% if their accuracy would otherwise be higher.

148.description: Boosts move power by 30% when the Pokemon moves after its target.

150.description: Transforms into the opposing Pokemon it faces upon entering battle.
